setting: open ground by day
note: the player scrapes the spilled sap into a phial and puts a drop to the tongue, as Skyrim's alchemy learns an ingredient by eating it: below skillAtLeast alchemy 15 the taste says only that it is sap; at 15 it reads fresh, drawn at the ring that dusk (fact.mq03.sap-fresh); the taste is also what brings the dream (hist-and-sap 'Sap': licking sap brings visions); a player who does not take it is offered it at the house table at stage 20

setting: at night
note: the dream is a walk to the door through the ring of root shapes; there are no watchers and no gate, so sneak is only the player's own quiet stance, the stage's one wonder beat (a wonder, not a test)

setting: before witnesses (a council, a hearing, a household)
note: the root-herald will not show a Lilmoth stranger the tending-ground until her regard is 30 (what the camp's cutting looked like when it closed is the persuasion); a failed try sends the player to the egg-tender, who is glad of anyone who has seen a dark uxith and shows it at 30 regard; a player with sneak 25 may slip into the tending-ground unseen

setting: at night
note: the tending-ground's fence is unwatched but for the herald's platform; a player who is not seen at the cut root has seen it without leave, and keeping unseen under her platform overhears what the village says: the leeches, Pays-Late, the hearing she holds, the Lilmoth man on the jetty

setting: at night
note: the faint drips run low on the reed leaves north from the workshop and pick up again past the leech water; the player follows them to the camp without being seen by the cell man who keeps its edge on the trail side; seen, the man gives the alarm and the camp is met by blade

setting: at night
note: the player follows the drips out to the camp unseen: a cell man keeps the camp's edge on the trail side, and a player he sees meets the camp by blade
